muhammad/5:11.ask: Mujahid and Ibn Ishaq: Banu al-Nadir's plot to drop a stone on him; others say Dhat al-Riqa' or a Bedouin. Keep under Banu al-Nadir?

muhammad/33:9.why: The armies came against you: al-Khandaq (Bukhari, Aisha on 33:10).

muhammad/33:26.why: He brought down those of the People of the Book who backed them: Banu Qurayza.

muhammad/63:1.why: The hypocrites; Ibn Ubayy's 'the mightier will expel the weaker' (Bukhari, Zayd ibn Arqam).
muhammad/63:1.ask: Ibn Ishaq places it at Banu al-Mustaliq; the hadith only says 'on a campaign'. Keep the title?

muhammad/48:1.why: Al-Fath was revealed on the return from al-Hudaybiya (Bukhari, Umar).

muhammad/2:196.why: If you are prevented, the offering: Ka'b ibn Ujra at al-Hudaybiya (Bukhari).
muhammad/2:196.ask: Only part of 2:196 (the fidya) is tied to al-Hudaybiya. Keep the whole ayah here?

muhammad/60:10.why: Believing women who emigrate: after the treaty (Bukhari, al-Miswar and Marwan).

muhammad/110:1.why: When the victory of Allah comes: the conquest of Makkah.
muhammad/110:1.ask: Ibn Abbas and Umar read al-Nasr as the sign of his death. Keep under the conquest?

muhammad/60:1.why: Do not take My enemy as allies: Hatib's letter before the conquest (Bukhari, Ali).

muhammad/9:25.why: The day of Hunayn, when your numbers pleased you.

muhammad/9:38.why: Why, when told to march out, do you cling to the earth: Tabuk.

muhammad/9:107.why: The mosque built for harm (masjid al-dirar).

muhammad/9:117.why: The three who were left behind (Bukhari, Ka'b ibn Malik).

muhammad/2:142.why: The fools will say what turned them from their qibla (Bukhari, al-Bara').

muhammad/58:1.why: She who disputed with you about her husband: Khawla (Bukhari, Aisha, ta'liq).

muhammad/24:11.why: Those who brought the lie: the ten ayat on Aisha (Bukhari, Aisha).
muhammad/24:11.ask: Aisha names ten ayat (24:11-20); 24:22 (Abu Bakr and Mistah) and 24:23-26 follow. Keep 24:11-26 as one event?

muhammad/49:1.why: Those who call you from behind the rooms: the delegation of Banu Tamim (Bukhari, Ibn al-Zubayr).

muhammad/9:1.why: Immunity from Allah: proclaimed at the hajj of 9 AH (Bukhari, Abu Hurayra).

muhammad/9:80.why: Ask forgiveness for them or not: Ibn Ubayy (Bukhari, Ibn Umar and Umar).

muhammad/5:3.why: This day I have perfected your religion: revealed at Arafa on the farewell hajj (Bukhari, Umar).

muhammad/33:36.why: Zayd and Zaynab; Muhammad is not the father of any of your men.

muhammad/33:6.why: The Prophet is closer to the believers; his wives are their mothers.

muhammad/66:1.why: Why do you forbid what Allah made lawful: the honey (Bukhari, Aisha).
muhammad/66:1.ask: Another report ties 66:1 to Mariya. The event joins it with the choice given to his wives (Bukhari, Umar's long hadith). Keep?

muhammad/47:2.why: Believe in what was sent down to Muhammad: one of four ayat that name him.

muhammad/33:28.why: Say to your wives: if you want this world's life, come, I will provide for you: the choice (Bukhari, Aisha).
